learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn about special magic marks that help us read and understand our sentences better!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A full stop is a small dot at the end of a telling sentence. It tells us to stop taking a breath and rest.
When we ask someone a question we do not use a full stop. We put a curvy question mark at the end like What is your name?

fun_activity.title: ❓ Ask and Tell
fun_activity.instructions: Write one telling sentence and put a full stop. Then write one asking sentence and put a question mark!

quick_recap: ⭐ Punctuation marks help us read sentences clearly.
⭐ A full stop is used when a sentence ends.
⭐ A question mark is used when we ask something.
